dz: 霍义之战:李元击败了一支苏伊王朝军队,打开了夺取帝国首都长安和最终建立唐朝的道路.
de: Battle of Huoyi: Li Yuan defeats a Sui dynasty army, opening the path to his capture of the imperial capital Chang'an and the eventual establishment of the Tang dynasty.
